post.summary: Reserve quota for a resumable ciphertext upload

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Required original item revision for replace/reseal initiation and completion, e.g. "2".

201.description: Reserved for one hour; each newly received part renews the deadline.

get.summary: List received parts or retrieve a completed result

404.description: Missing, expired or another account’s upload

put.summary: Stream an immutable, retryable ciphertext part at its offset
put.description: Zero-based parts are exactly 32 MiB except the final remaining bytes. Actual streamed bytes are counted. Missing Content-Length is supported. Received parts are never overwritten.

400.description: Invalid part number or short body

post.summary: Validate and commit a fully received envelope
post.description: Checks all parts, envelope header, recipients and standing. Creates an item, replaces the If-Match item or returns a reseal receipt. Safe to retry: successful results are retained for 24 hours. A simultaneous completion returns locker.upload.busy (409); query status and retry. Invalid envelopes discard the session.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Required original item revision for replace/reseal initiation and completion, e.g. "2".

200.description: Created/replaced item, or {envelope_ref, header} for reseal

409.description: Missing parts or completion still running

412.description: Item revision changed or If-Match differs

bytes.description: Complete ciphertext envelope length, including padding and framing.

result.description: Original item or reseal receipt, available for 24 hours after successful completion.
